jamie: quick follow-up from today

matt: current burn ~ $5.4M/mo; forecasted net burn ~ $3.2M/mo by year-end in baseline. shared model (view-only) in the all-hands doc.

sara: procurement thresholds? vendor delays were raised.

devon: new rule: >=$10k finance + cost-owner; >=$50k exec sponsor. Standard SLA 3bd, new vendors up to 7bd. Tag @devon + @finance-bot to expedite (48-72h target, legal/sec still required).

jamie: can leadership post a 1-paragraph FAQ with card limits and the approval flow?

elaine: will post a pinned FAQ and a 90s Loom tomorrow.
